item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "2828382b1598c6eaf7bbca3c951b794dad548c0bd5ccb5f2159e4a0c9ac652b3",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "Abbreviation for LocalDef005 on vectors indexed by Fin m.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specializes the vector derivative equation to m = 2.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "Abbreviation for LocalDef006 with the same six arguments.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the right side precisely the scalar derivative and equation predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "The real matrix with rows (0, bulkModulus) and (density⁻¹, 0).",
      "effect_on_target": "Its product with (px, ux) is (bulkModulus·ux, density⁻¹·px).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "The vector-valued function q(x,t) = (pressure(x,t), velocity(x,t)), in that coordinate order.",
      "effect_on_target": "Identifies coordinate 0 with pressure and coordinate 1 with velocity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "There exist vectors qt and qx such that the time slice has derivative qt at t, the spatial slice has derivative qx at x, and qt + coefficient·qx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires both vector partial derivatives to exist at the selected point and satisfy the matrix equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "There exist real pt, px, ut, ux giving the respective time and space derivatives of pressure and velocity at (x,t), with pt + bulkModulus·ux = 0 and ut + density⁻¹·px = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires all four scalar partial derivatives and both scalar equations simultaneously.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on real-valued functions on any index type is continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of scalar multiplication for the vector derivative predicate; adds no hypothesis on pressure or velocity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "LocalDef008",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on the real numbers is continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar codomain structure for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence: each proposition implies the other.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts both directions between the vector and scalar formulations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the vector dimension 2.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Inequality, defined as the negation of equality.",
      "effect_on_target": "The hypothesis is density ≠ 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural numeral using its specified numeral instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets 0 as a real number and 2 as a natural dimension.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "All independent variables, parameters, scalar values, and matrix entries are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real additive zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides zero in the density restriction, matrix entries, and scalar equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's zero as its numeral 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the written zeros denote the applicable additive zeros.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "instOfNatNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural numeral n as n itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the target dimension to exactly two.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying function from a function-like object.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows the matrix-construction equivalence to act as a function.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Equiv",
      "meaning": "An equivalence between types, consisting of mutually inverse maps.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports identification of a doubly indexed function with a matrix.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Equiv.instEquivLike",
      "meaning": "Exposes an equivalence's forward and inverse functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "The forward function of Matrix.of is used to construct the coefficient matrix.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "EquivLike.toFunLike",
      "meaning": "Views an equivalence-like object as function-like using its forward map.",
      "effect_on_target": "Adds no transformation beyond applying Matrix.of.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin n is the type of natural indices strictly less than n.",
      "effect_on_target": "The target has exactly coordinates 0 and 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates all indices in Fin n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Matrix-vector multiplication sums over both indices of Fin 2.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Inv.inv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the inversion operation of the supplied instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the reciprocal operation for density.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "Matrix",
      "meaning": "A matrix is a function from a row index and a column index to an entry.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coefficient is a real 2 by 2 matrix with row-first indexing.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "Matrix.of",
      "meaning": "The identity equivalence between doubly indexed functions and matrices.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the displayed rows and entries without transposition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "Matrix.vecCons",
      "meaning": "Prepends an entry to a finite vector, placing it at index 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the pressure-velocity order and the coefficient matrix's row and column order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "Matrix.vecEmpty",
      "meaning": "The unique vector on the empty index type Fin 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Terminates the explicitly constructed two-entry vectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "Real.instInv",
      "meaning": "Real multiplicative inversion, with the field convention that the inverse of zero is zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Under density ≠ 0, density⁻¹ is the ordinary reciprocal 1/density.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "All derivative assertions and equations within each side must hold together.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed field structure and obtains nontriviality of the norm from dense norm values.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar field structure needed for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Forgets division structure while retaining semiring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real algebraic operations for module construction without changing them.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The scalar residuals equal real zero, and the vector residual equals zero in every coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over a witness satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Derivative values are existentially quantified inside each side, after the outer functions, parameters, and point are fixed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains a field's semiring, reciprocal, and division structure while forgetting additive inverses as required structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real scalar algebra and preserves the inverse-zero convention.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite enumeration containing every element of a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the coordinate sum in matrix-vector multiplication a finite sum.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "The addition operation selected by a heterogeneous addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Denotes real addition in scalar equations and pointwise addition in the vector equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "The multiplication operation selected by a heterogeneous multiplication instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Denotes real multiplication in the scalar residuals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the stated derivative at the specified point, using the neighborhood filter there with the comparison point fixed.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires ordinary derivatives of the one-variable slices, with real or two-coordinate real codomain; it is not merely a total derivative-value operator.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "Matrix.mulVec",
      "meaning": "Matrix-vector multiplication: coordinate i is the dot product of row i with the vector, namely the sum of M(i,j)·v(j).",
      "effect_on_target": "Produces (bulkModulus·ux, density⁻¹·px) from the spatial derivative vector (px, ux).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the associativity requirement while preserving commutative ring operations without a specified unit.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a weaker algebraic structure for real matrix operations without altering entries or arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the multiplicative commutativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Continues the inheritance of the same real operations needed for matrix multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, multiplication, distributivity, and zero multiplication while forgetting additive inverses as required structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the algebraic structure accepted by Matrix.mulVec.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the commutative additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides addition and zero for finite coordinate sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the norm and metric while preserving the ring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects real normed algebra to the algebra used in matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplicative commutativity while retaining seminormed ring data.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of the additive and topological structures used for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and pseudometric from a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real additive topological structure underlying scalar differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplication associativity as required structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows inherited real semiring operations to meet weaker operation requirements.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real normed field used by derivative and scalar-module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains normed commutative ring operations while forgetting the specified unit.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves ordinary real arithmetic and metric in the matrix-operation instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed commutative ring as seminormed, preserving its norm, operations, and underlying pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real topological and additive structures without imposing new function hypotheses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field operations and laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real field arithmetic, including reciprocal.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Makes a normed field a normed vector space over itself, with scalar multiplication given by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Scalar derivatives take values in the usual real vector space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure from a normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real-linear structure required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "The module structure on functions, with operations defined coordinatewise.",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector derivative values belong to the usual real vector space of functions Fin 2 → Real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The coordinatewise additive commutative group on a family of functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the vector additive group used in differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Pi.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Function addition satisfies (f + g)(i) = f(i) + g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector equation adds the two residual coordinates separately.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Pi.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero function has value zero at each index.",
      "effect_on_target": "The right side of the vector equation is (0, 0).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "The product topology induced by the coordinate projections.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector derivatives use the usual product topology on two real coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real metric to the topology used in derivative limits.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field has densely available positive norm values.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the nontrivially normed real field required for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Ordinary real addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines addition in scalar residuals and vector coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure of the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive codomain structure required for scalar derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "Ordinary real multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the coefficient-times-derivative products.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "The ring structure of the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real algebra used by vector modules and finite sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The real commutative ring equipped with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the algebraic operations and topology in the dependency chain the ordinary real ones.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with its usual norm and metric, including multiplicative norm and inverse-zero laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the standard real field and analytic structure used throughout.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real distance is |x − y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "Derivative limits use the ordinary real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure from a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains real addition, multiplication, zero, and one for module and sum constructions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains semiring and division data while forgetting multiplicative commutativity as required structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real operations in the scalar-structure inheritance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the specified unit while preserving seminormed commutative ring data.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of the real seminormed additive group used by derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Forgets the specified multiplicative unit from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides weaker real algebraic structure without changing arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology underlying a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the topology for the real derivative predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary addition as heterogeneous addition with identical input and output types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves addition notation to real addition or coordinatewise vector addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary multiplication as heterogeneous multiplication with identical input and output types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves scalar products to real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets additive commutativity as required structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies additive monoid data for scalar-action structures without changing vector or scalar addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Joint continuity of the scalar multiplication map (a, v) ↦ a·v.",
      "effect_on_target": "Is a structural prerequisite for the derivative codomains, supplied by D007 and D008.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a multiplicative action from an action distributing over addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar action underlying real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action of a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real module structures to their scalar multiplication operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Forgets the specified identity while retaining associative multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides scalar multiplication's underlying semigroup structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real multiplicative monoid for scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a semigroup action from a monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the same real scalar action in the instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed commutative ring underlying a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Keeps the real norm, metric, and ring arithmetic consistent in the analytic structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "Pi.instSMul",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication on functions is coordinatewise: (a·f)(i) = a·f(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector derivatives use ordinary coordinatewise real scaling.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the action operation appearing in derivative and continuity structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplicative commutativity while retaining seminormed ring data.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of the usual real pseudometric.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric underlying a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the metric-derived topology for scalar multiplication and derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Retains multiplication, one, zero, and their monoid-with-zero laws from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real multiplicative structure used by scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D088",
      "name": "instSMulOfMul",
      "meaning": "Defines scalar multiplication of a type on itself by its multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real scalar multiplication on Real is ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "For every pair of functions pressure, velocity : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, whose first argument is x and second argument is t.",
      "For every real bulkModulus K, density ρ, spatial coordinate x, and time coordinate t.",
      "On the left side, there exist qt, qx ∈ ℝ², chosen after the functions, parameters, and point are fixed.",
      "On the right side, there exist pt, px, ut, ux ∈ ℝ, in that quantifier order, chosen after the functions, parameters, and point are fixed. These witnesses are local to the right side and are not separately quantified common witnesses across the equivalence."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "ρ ≠ 0."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
